metadata.purpose: Merge one piped source and configured other Observables; bounded concurrency starts later sources FIFO.

conditions: Every connected input next forwards exactly once in actual arrival order.
Output completion requires every input completion; any input error terminates immediately.
A bounded concurrency limit delays subscriptions to later supplied sources, not their values.

scope.parameters: Pipeable deprecated merge export with 2 other valid Observable inputs; concurrency 2; no scheduler.
scope.callbacks: No callbacks. Input payloads are opaque and preserve identity.
scope.time: No internal clock; all inputs supply their notification times. Source-first subscriptions are ordered.
scope.reentrancy: Atomic nonreentrant subscriptions; synchronous input delivery during acquisition is excluded.
exclusions: Deprecated scheduler overload and Promise/Iterable conversions, synchronous sources during subscription setup.
Reentrant observers and source callbacks, teardown throws and unbounded scenario counts over 32 others.

initialization.sourceSubscription: Acquire source 0 before other Observable arguments; up to concurrency limit.

ownership.sharing: Merge does not create sharing; each result subscription independently acquires input subscriptions.
ownership.reset: Fresh live and pending indices; no shared queue between consumers.

resources.owner: result execution; generation is input argument index

dispatch.actionSemantics: Preserve event arrival order and release completed sources; concurrency slots are FIFO.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between external notifications; cancel all live sources silently, discard pending.

controls.description: zero or more live inputs and ordered pending sources
